verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Discord supports threads that can be public or private within a channel (discord-docs-37, discord-docs-38, discord-docs-45), implying some channel-level privacy/membership control, but there is no direct documentation in the pack about creating and managing public vs. private *channels* themselves, role-based permissions, or membership controls at the channel/server level. Missing for 10: explicit docs on channel permission/role settings, private channel creation workflow, and membership management tooling for admins.
